# Generated by scripts/ci/generate_workflows.py; edit source inputs and regenerate.
name: Onesa protected Docs metadata
'on':
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      action:
        description: Qualify metadata, approve its exact digest, or revoke the prior handoff
        type: choice
        options:
        - revoke
        - qualify
        - approve
        default: revoke
        required: true
      native_metadata:
        description: 'Qualify only: sanitized counts/hashes, at most 32 KiB; never private files or credentials'
        type: string
        default: ''
        required: false
      producer_sha256:
        description: 'Qualify only: independently reviewed native producer hash'
        type: string
        default: ''
        required: false
      qualification_run:
        description: 'Approve only: exact successful metadata qualification run ID'
        type: string
        default: ''
        required: false
      evidence_digest:
        description: 'Approve only: exact reviewed qualification record SHA256'
        type: string
        default: ''
        required: false
permissions:
  contents: read
  actions: read
  pull-requests: read
concurrency:
  group: onesa-protected-docs-metadata
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  metadata:
    name: Protected Docs metadata custody
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.repository == 'DruHustle/onesa-ug' && github.repository_id
      == '1444746154' && github.actor == 'DruHustle' && github.triggering_actor == 'DruHustle' && github.ref ==
      'refs/heads/main' && github.run_attempt == 1
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
    - name: Verify hosted execution, visibility and included-allowance policy
      env:
        GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        EXPECTED_PRIVATE: ${{ github.event.repository.private }}
        PRIVATE_VALIDATION_ENABLED: ${{ vars.ONESA_PRIVATE_HOSTED_VALIDATION_ENABLED }}
      run: |
        test "$RUNNER_ENVIRONMENT" = github-hosted
        actual=$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --jq ".private")
        test "$actual" = "$EXPECTED_PRIVATE" || { echo "Repository visibility changed"; exit 1; }
        if [ "$actual" = true ] && [ "$PRIVATE_VALIDATION_ENABLED" != true ]; then
          echo "Private hosted verification requires explicit included-allowance opt-in"
          exit 1
        fi
    - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1
      with:
        persist-credentials: false
        ref: ${{ github.sha }}
        fetch-depth: 0
    - uses: actions/setup-python@5fda3b95a4ea91299a34e894583c3862153e4b97
      with:
        python-version: '3.11'
    - name: Validate source-bound metadata without publication authority
      env:
        GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      run: python3 onesa-ai-platform/scripts/release/oracle_docs_internal_canonical.py --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/protected-docs-metadata/record.json"
    - name: Retain count and hash metadata only
      uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9
      with:
        name: onesa-protected-docs-metadata
        path: ${{ runner.temp }}/protected-docs-metadata/record.json
        if-no-files-found: error
        retention-days: 7
